name: God Answering Prayers
overview: Scripture reveals that God actively listens and responds to the prayers of His people, often answering even before they call, as Isaiah 65:24 affirms. Believers are encouraged to trust and delight in the Lord, assured that He will grant the desires of their hearts when aligned with faith, as shown in Psalms 37:4 and Mark 11:24. Jesus teaches that unwavering faith enables believers to receive what they ask for in prayer, emphasizing the necessity of abiding in Him and His word, a truth highlighted in John 15:7 and Matthew 21:21. Furthermore, casting burdens upon the Lord brings sustaining strength, illustrating God's faithful care in response to prayer (Psalms 55:22).
